name: flow
description: Flow — an infinite flow canvas built with NSH.

scripts.check: nsh check src && vp check --deny-warnings && bun run test:lint && bun run check:rust
scripts.check:fix: nsh check src && vp check --fix --deny-warnings && bun run test:lint && bun run fmt:rust && bun run check:rust
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src/native/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src/native/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
